ValidationRule.description: QCC: Prevent Passenger from editing once the Event is closed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(Text(Event__r.Status__c) == 'Closed', NOT(ISCHANGED(RecoveryIsCreated__c)), PRIORVALUE(Passenger__c) != Null, ISCHANGED( Passenger__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Passenger Record can't be Edited on a closed Flight Event. Please Re-Open the Flight Event to update Passenger Record.
